ch0246_00_beet_salon/8201_2002_0200_10:
There is no more valuable way to spend
your time than in my presence.
ch0246_00_beet_salon/8201_2003_0300_10:
If you’d like my tutelage, I suppose I could
make time to teach you a thing or two,
[Name:PlayerNickname ].
ch0246_00_beet_salon/8201_2101_0500_10: No need for thanks. I had extras.
ch0246_00_beet_salon/8201_2102_0600_10: Take this to commemorate seeing me today.
ch0246_00_beet_salon/8201_2103_0800_10:
I’d like to present you with this,
[Name:PlayerNickname ].
ch0246_00_beet_salon/8201_2103_0900_10:
As an elite, I can assure you it is the best
present I could find.
ch0246_00_beet_salon/8201_2201_1100_10: Eager to hear from me, I see.
ch0246_00_beet_salon/8201_2202_1200_10:
I presume you have some helpful info,
[Name:PlayerNickname ]?
ch0246_00_beet_salon/8201_2203_1300_10:
I suppose it can’t be avoided. I’ll have a
chat with you, [Name:PlayerNickname ].
ch0246_00_beet_salon/8201_2302_1400_10:
Is this for me? I suppose some thanks are in
order...
ch0246_00_beet_salon/8201_2301_1500_10:
Oh? This is a rare display of good taste
from you.
ch0246_00_beet_salon/8201_2301_1600_10: If it’s a gift, I certainly won’t turn it down.
ch0246_00_beet_salon/8201_2402_1700_10:
Let’s wrap this up. If you’ve got time later,
I’ll join you again.
ch0246_00_beet_salon/8201_2401_1800_10:
That wasn’t a bad use of my time. Please
free up your schedule so we can do this
again.
ch0246_00_beet_salon/8201_2401_1900_10:
If I invite you to something, your only option
is to accept!
ch0246_00_beet_salon/8001_0701_0100_10:
There are many chatty people at this lodge...
They seem to go out of their way to gather
here.
ch0246_00_beet_salon/8001_0701_0200_10:
If I’m not interested in what someone is
saying, it makes me want to leave.
ch0246_00_beet_salon/8001_0701_0300_10:
Humoring such chatter is annoying,
but I suppose it’s fine once in a while.
ch0246_00_beet_salon/8002_0701_0100_10:
I used to think the need to connect with
others was an indication of weakness.
ch0246_00_beet_salon/8002_0701_0200_10: But my views have changed some.
ch0246_00_beet_salon/8002_0701_0300_10:
I’ve found that having many opponents to
test my skills against makes me stronger.
ch0246_00_beet_salon/8003_0701_0100_10:
Even if someone were to make an
impression on me, it wouldn’t change
how I live my life.
ch0246_00_beet_salon/8003_0701_0200_10:
You seem the type to be heavily inspired by
those around you.
ch0246_00_beet_salon/8003_0701_0300_10:
If you try to use my life as inspiration,
it’ll overwhelm you. That can’t be helped.
ch0246_00_beet_salon/8003_0701_0400_10: In the end, we must each live our own life.
